name: Never Saddle on Quality
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
We're getting ready to send a team of rams to reinforce the Alterac expedition, but we've run out of material to make their saddles.

Collect pelts from the largest, fiercest leopards to the east and bring them to me. It's biting cold up there and our forces deserve nothing but the finest pelts to keep them warm!
narrative.objectives: Collect 6 Pristine Leopard Pelts and deliver them to Amberstill Ranch.
narrative.offerRewardText: These pelts will make excellent saddles. You've done the Alliance proud, champion!
narrative.requestItemsText: You look chilly, champion. How goes the hunt?
